caption: The drawing features a single shoe depicted in a side view, positioned centrally within a large rectangular boundary sketched on a light beige background. The shoe is primarily shaded in black with some gray tones, suggesting texture and form, while the interior of the shoe is colored in a light pink hue. The design of the shoe is simple with a low heel and a slightly squared toe box. Above and to the right of the main shoe drawing, there is a smaller rectangular inset containing a simple black outline of the shoe's sole, viewed from above, with minimal detail and no additional color. The rest of the page is mostly empty.
title: Slipper
